description: This file contains helper functions for extracting MAC addresses and reading configuration data specific to the Phicomm K2T device, utilizing external libraries for JSON handling and system operations.

methods.name: k2t_config_load
methods.description: Loads the device's configuration from the memory technology device (MTD) partition named 'config', parses the size of the JSON data, and loads the JSON content for further processing.

methods.name: k2t_get_mac
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address for the specified interface or device info from the JSON configuration loaded earlier.
